title: PartType::Message comment contradicts behavior
description: In mime-tree/src/parse.rs at the PartType::Message arm (lines 148-155), the comment says 'Nested RFC 5322 message — recurse into the nested message root part using this crate part-tree walker, mapped to a synthetic Message wrapper. We treat the nested message as a single leaf.' The comment describes a plan that was not implemented; the code discards children and the nested message is returned as a leaf with no children at all. A contributor reading the comment will expect recursion, and may be confused by 'let _ = nested'. The comment should be replaced with a one-sentence description of what actually happens and why (e.g. 'Treated as an opaque leaf; decode_body_value handles message/rfc822 bodies on demand').
